summary.text: Wendy Norman is the Democratic candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 31B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Rod Furniss (R).
Norman, a teacher, earned a master's degree in education from Idaho State University.

paragraphs.text: Wendy Norman was born in Idaho Falls, Idaho, and earned a master's degree in education from Idaho State University.
Her career experience includes working as a teacher.

Norman was the Democratic nominee for Idaho's 2nd Congressional District in 2022, advancing unopposed from the May 17 primary and losing the November 8 general election to incumbent Michael K. Simpson (R), 63.6 percent to 36.4 percent.
